// Blood II's projectile classes and the constants a mod's
// Mod\Projectiles.txt can set for them. GENERATED by `testBlood2Tables
// --dump projectiles` from Blood2/ObjectDLL/BloodModProjectiles.cpp and
// ProjectileConstants.h; do not edit, regenerate. testBlood2Tables proves
// that loading this file changes nothing.
//
// A section is a class, as a weapon's ProjectileClass names it.  Every
// class takes DamageType (a DAMAGE_TYPE_ name without the prefix),
// LifeTime, Gravity, TrailFX (an OBJFX_ name, or NONE) and Explosion, over
// the values its constructor gives it, which are not listed here: the
// classes are not a table.  With Mod\AI.txt's [Options] Trace = TRUE the
// server prints them, for each class the game makes.  BounceCount and
// TimeDelay are listed under the classes that have them; the values
// below are the class constants' retail ones.  A mod names only what it
// changes:
//
//     [CGrenade]
//     LifeTime = 2.0
//
// A section named after no class is a new one, with Base = the class
// it is built on, retail's or the file's; it has that class's keys.
// CModProjectile is a class made to be a Base, every value a key.
//
// Blood2/ObjectDLL/BloodModProjectiles.h has the rest.
